signals.text: 2 open PM roles across 1 US office
1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Own the integrated product development and launch schedule, connecting team milestones, hardware timelines, and company goals into a single critical path the whole company can…
Define credible milestones, owners, dependencies, and dates that align with the overall product schedule, bringing clarity to complex problems
Manage cross-team dependencies and blockers, making handoffs explicit, surfacing risks early, and driving or escalating resolution before they reach a critical milestone
Maintain strong cross-functional communication, keeping teams aligned on status, priorities, schedule changes, risks, and decisions so work proceeds from a shared understanding
Drive the fastest credible path to launch by parallelizing work, accelerating decisions, shortening feedback loops, and removing constraints on the critical path
Own platform product strategy and deliver a clear, prioritized roadmap that answers why a thing matters, not just what ships next
Drive measurable gains in customer confidence and platform adoption, so customers succeed on the platform rather than working around it
Work closely with our partnerships team to understand customers, both commercial and consumer, and anticipate customer needs in long-term roadmaps
Lead API improvement while customers actively depend on the product, designing platform APIs that stay reliable for the long term without versioning or breaking customer software
Simplify the platform experience by making complex technology feel obvious, reducing friction, and creating secure, intuitive paths through the product
